subject: Kickoff: Global MetNet nowcasting as a platform data product
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off Global MetNet. The pitch: our precipitation nowcasting model produces probabilistic forecasts at 5km spatial and 15-minute temporal resolution out to 12 hours, with real-time forecasts initialized every 30 minutes - logistics and agriculture customers on the platform have asked for exactly this, and today they buy it from third parties.

Two deliverables this window: (1) stand up the historical reforecast archive (2020 to present, 3-hour cadence, 8 initializations/day) as a queryable platform dataset, including the optimal probability thresholds for converting to categorical rain/no-rain; (2) a scoped serving plan for the real-time feed, with Shipyard.

Milestones: archive schema by 2/27, eval report by 3/27, go/no-go on the real-time feed 4/15.

Milan on serving, Tereza data pipeline, Wei and Vera on eval. Jelena - compute and staffing by Friday?

Dmitri
